Subject: Supplier onboarding exception — PO waiver criteria & e-forms

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for the kickoff call this morning. Per our conversation, ClearGraph is starting a short pilot (est. $6k total over 3 months) and is asking whether the pilot can proceed without a formal PO while we complete vendor setup. Procurement asked we capture:

- Completed onboarding form (vendor-side)
- W-9 or equivalent tax docs
- Short pilot SOW and invoice cadence
- Evidence of indemnity / insurance limits if available

Would you be able to send the filled onboarding form and W-9 today? If you prefer, we can accept e-signed copies.

Cc'ing Marissa (procurement lead) and Naomi (CS ops) so we can get an exception stamped as a provisional "invoice-only" path — subject to the checklist below.

Next steps I propose:
1) Sarah uploads onboarding form + W-9 (by EOD)
2) Naomi confirms SOW/invoice cadence and flags any data residency questions
3) Marissa reviews evidence and approves provisional no-PO for pilot, with a cap of $10k

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: request_checklist.docx (see required evidence list)

Ben / Naomi,

Thanks — attaching the onboarding form and our W-9. We've also attached a short pilot SOW that outlines deliverables and a monthly invoice schedule (net 30).

Quick answers to your checklist:
- Billing contact: accounting@cleargraph.com
- Invoice cadence: Monthly, first invoice upon delivery of pilot milestone 1 (demo)
- Insurance: We carry general liability and cyber liability; limits are listed on page 2 of the onboarding form.
- Data handling: No PHI expected; we'll sign your standard DPA if required.

Attachments: ClearGraph_onboarding_form.pdf, ClearGraph_W9.pdf, pilot_statement_of_work.pdf

Let me know if you need anything else to expedite the provisional path. We're keen to kick off next week.

Best,

Team —

I've reviewed ClearGraph's onboarding packet and the W-9. Summary and decision:

- Insurance: general liability and cyber liability coverages meet our minimum thresholds.
- Tax docs: W-9 is valid and matches business name.
- SOW: short pilot SOW is acceptable; invoicing cadence and amounts are clear.

Decision: Procurement will approve a provisional "invoice-only" exemption to the PO requirement for this pilot, capped at $10,000 total. Conditions:
1) Invoices must include the HubSpot company ID: 67890 or reference Redwood deal ID RG-2025-1147.
2) Procurement reserves the right to require a PO if cumulative spend against ClearGraph exceeds $10k or scope expands.
3) ClearGraph must execute our standard DPA or provide explicit written data handling commitments within 5 business days.
4) Procurement will upload the procurement_checklist.xlsx to the vendor record; accounting should route invoices to accounting@cleargraph.com.

I've uploaded the checklist and added a HubSpot company note. DocuSign link to the provisional approval is: https://redwood-inference.app/docusign/ABC123

Marissa Cole
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference
